$comment: Words and settings every page shares. Change a sentence here and every page that uses it changes with it. See UPDATING.md.
name: WittyMediaServer

say.description: Your films, shows, discs, music, books and games, on every screen in your home. A self-hosted media server that plays DVDs and Blu-rays with their real menus, in any browser.
say.server: Self-hosted software that keeps your films, shows, discs, music, books and games on a computer you own, and streams them to every screen in your home. It plays DVDs and Blu-rays with their real menus, in any browser.
say.serverWhere: Install it once, on the computer that holds your media. Every other screen reaches it through a web browser, so no app is needed.
say.client: Apps for TV boxes, phones, tablets and desktops that connect to your WittyMediaServer, for the devices where a browser isn't the right fit.
say.clientOptional: Optional. The server's whole interface already runs in any web browser.
say.player: A desktop player for discs and files, with real DVD and Blu-ray menus. It plays straight from a drive, a disc image or a folder, with no server and no account.
say.reader: Read and annotate books, PDFs and comics on your own device, with no server and nothing uploaded.
say.modules: Modules add what your server can do, such as DVD menus, streamed games or live TV. Each is a project of its own, signed, and added from Settings → Modules while the server keeps running.
say.alpha: Alpha software: it changes quickly and can fail or lose data. Keep backups, including your data folder, before you upgrade.
say.shotsNote: Pictures from a test server filled with openly licensed and public-domain media.
say.encrypted: Copy-protected discs and encrypted broadcasts are refused with a plain message. Nothing here unlocks them.
say.privacy: This site has no cookies, trackers or analytics. Your theme choice is kept in your own browser.
